name: Practice: mock gap, then mock window, then the pad
description: For the practice course in course_maps/practice_mock_gap_and_window.json only: cross the gap, then the window, then land on the pad. The stages are named after the checkpoints: 'mock gap' and 'mock window'.
source: Our own choice, for practice flight 'mock_gap_and_window' (team_nav/practice_flights/README.md). Not from the rulebook.
cruise_height_source: Our own choice: the same as the competition missions, so the practice flies like the real run. The window's middle is also at 0.8 m, so the drone barely changes height there.
